722872701.text: "And well, if I can get my fill of food, then sure! I'll follow Seishimaru." Haha, the character I'm playing this time is pretty cute.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for the two performers and talk to them

722870101.text: You're the one who was involved in the screening, you're...

722870103.text: Yes, I'm so sorry, I didn't remember your name.

722870104.text: It's my fault for having a faulty memory. Sorry I gave you guys a hard time when we were filming.

722870105.text: I know Xavier is from Fontaine. My most important person is also an outlander, so I understand how difficult it is to be alone in a foreign land.

722870106.text: I was picky in the past and caused him trouble. Looking back on it pricks at my conscience.

722870108.text: Is this what Mr. Xavier wants? Th-Then please allow me to participate.

722870109.text: I was called in to participate in the shooting before, though I was only paid the price of a meal. But money that's paid is paid, so I will finish what I started.

722870111.text: Got it. I'll go tell my family later that I'm going to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Komore Teahouse</color>.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for the two performers and talk to them

722870201.text: #You've come, {NICKNAME}? I know it is rude to say this, but...

722870202.text: I'm sorry! May I ask if Mr. Xavier still needs an actress?

722870203.text: I left in a rage, and failed Master in her painstaking efforts of expressing concern as well as messing up the quest given by the head of the family. I have disgraced the Yashiro Commission.

722870204.text: Master has reprimanded me, so please, I beseech you, please mention this to Xavier so I may do my duty.

722870205.text: What did Furuta say to you?

722870206.text: No, no, Master only asked me to think about why I want to stay with the Yashiro Commission.

722870207.text: I made a vow to the head of the family and to the Kamisato Clan that I would never do anything detrimental to the name of the Kamisato Clan in a fit of pique.

722870208.text: I was too reckless, and indolent, and as a Shuu... no, as a servant of the Kamisato Clan, I was very much out of line.

722870209.text: And Mr. Xavier was actually very kind to me. Once again, I... I'm so sorry!

722870212.text: You mean I still have a chance, and I can go and apologize to Mr. Xavier to make up for my mistake?

722870213.text: Wonderful, wonderful! I must do well this time. Your generosity is appreciated.

722870215.text: I'll set out right away after I've tidied up my appearance.

722872301.text: Perfect, this is the story I had in mind.

722872302.text: #{NICKNAME}, Mr. Sasano, and Miss Koharu, the performances you've contributed touched my heart! Thank you!

722872305.text: It's true, you two. This story has a perfect ending to me.

722872306.text: I've been hoping to film a perfect swashbuckler film, and now I finally realized this dream.

722872307.text: Now I can hold my chest up high and hand this film over to the Yashiro Commissioner.

722872308.text: I feel very lucky to be part of this story too.

722872309.text: Speaking of which, this story is really familiar. I keep feeling like I've heard it before.

722872310.text: Have you heard about the legend of Seishimaru? I heard about it only a while ago from the owner of Uyuu Restaurant.

722872311.text: Mr. Okazaki? In the story I heard, Seishimaru had the surname Kawasaki, or was it Shimazaki? I can't really remember.

722872312.text: It's okay, folklores usually have many versions, and the same can be said about legends of Fontaine and Sumeru, too.

722872315.text: True, true. If Sumeru or Fontaine or even Natlan local legends were used as the source material, what sort of story would we have? Ah, I would certainly love to make some films there too.

722872316.text: *cough* But before that, I should try to find an opportunity to return to Fontaine. I've heard that some of my colleagues have also come up with machines with functions similar to the Film Kamera.

722872317.text: They have even given those machines all manner of names, such as the "Moving Picture Device" or the "Motion Picture Machine"... and they're currently arguing over who should get the patent to boot.

722872318.text: Well, I shan't bother with this... pointless quibbling. My one priority is to continue refining my Film Kamera.

722872319.text: Well then, I shall see you later, Traveler. Should we meet again, perhaps you'd like to help me shoot a film once more...?

722870301.text: Mr. Sasano, you have much longer lines in this scene, so you must memorize them well and not make any mistakes.

722870302.text: Is it too difficult for you?

722870303.text: I thought I would end up struggling with the previous script, but I was surprised to find out that Xavier had written a new one in just one day.

722870304.text: How can I do anything but my best after that? Don't worry, I've memorized my lines carefully.

722870305.text: I'm very confident in this script, and I'll do my best to act it well.

722870306.text: Okay, Miss Koharu, about the script... Do you have anything that you need me to explain?

722870307.text: This scene requires a very emotional performance from you. I hope you can portray a playful girl who sells tea.

722870308.text: I've rehearsed the lines many times on my own after I received the script, so I'm sure I can perform better than before.

722870309.text: Looks like we're late. Everyone's already rehearsing.

722870312.text: Phew... Good, now the main actors are all here.

722870313.text: #I've brought the new script as we agreed yesterday, {NICKNAME}. Do you want to read it?

722870314.text: The story is based on the legend of Seishimaru. Other than the Seishimaru and Wakayama characters, I've added a new original character called Yano Machiko.

722870315.text: Paimon thinks it flows much better than before!

722870316.text: Many details can be embellished, given more time, but it's already a challenge to shoot all of this with my current ability.

722870317.text: Okay, enough chitchat. We have to bring out our professionalism.

722870318.text: Mr. Sasano and Miss Koharu from the supporting cast are ready. As for the set, I've decided to shoot the first scene in the Komore Teahouse.

722870319.text: So, Mr. Thoma has asked the owner of the teahouse for a favor and fortunately, we can borrow a private room there.

722870320.text: Now we're just waiting for the main character, and that's you. We can start the shooting any time when you're ready.

722870321.text: You can read the script first. There's no need to be nervous. I've marked all the important lines, so take your time.

722870322.text: If you make a mistake in a line, we can re-shoot it to get the most desirable effect.

722870601.text: I still need more time to read the script.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Xavier to begin the shoot

722872901.text: Just my luck to have run into a tough nut!

722872903.text: No, my lord, Master, we aren't saying anything bad about you, I swear!

722872601.text: "It's been a while, Seishimaru." Yeah, Xavier said that it's best to be as calm as possible...

722871001.text: Everyone did a good job. The effect was perfect this time.

722871002.text: Mr. Sasano's performance was full of power and conveyed the charisma of his character, Wakayama Keisuke.

722871003.text: Um, Mr. Xavier... There's something I'm curious about. Can I ask you about it?

722871004.text: Of course. Ah, I must say, Machiko was very lively and playful earlier, just as I'd envisioned.

722871005.text: Wakayama Keisuke chose to let Seishimaru take revenge on him, and that's actually to make Seishimaru cool his temper, right?

722871006.text: It was out of the goodness of his heart, so would it be better if this character sounded gentler? The current lines feel a little... cruel.

722871007.text: I, too, considered making Keisuke a gentleman, but eventually I gave him this cold and stiff style.

722871008.text: But you're right... This story should have another possibility.

722871009.text: Hm... Should I make more adjustments?

722871011.text: Mr. Xavier, there is no need to doubt yourself. The reason I asked is that I don't understand why the script was written that way.

722871012.text: I can sense that you are very talented in writing. Please continue what you were planning on doing.

722871013.text: Thank you for saying that, Miss Koharu. Then let's carry on.

722871014.text: For the next scene, I'd like to go to <color=#00E1FFFF>Nazuchi Beach</color>. Given the lighting of location, it should be shot in the <color=#00E1FFFF>evening</color>.

722871015.text: Let's all get ready and start shooting the next scene in the <color=#00E1FFFF>evening</color>.

722871101.text: This thing about "shadows" has nothing to do with us. Make payments and we're done.

722871102.text: Just pay money and you can shoot "shadows" in this area, heheh.

722871103.text: Tanaka, you can't say that. Whether you can shoot the shadows well after paying depends entirely on Hifumi's mood.

722871104.text: Friends, I've applied in advance to the Yashiro Commission. The filming is in full compliance with the Inazuman regulations.

722871105.text: If you are willing, you can participate too. We happen to need a few more actors for the next scene.

722871106.text: To be involved in the process of creating art is much more fun than money.

722871107.text: Money is the only thing on their minds. Saying this stuff to them is useless... *sigh* Just when the shooting was finally going well... Why did we have to run into these guys?

722871108.text: Paimon's starting to feel sorry for them.

722871109.text: Poor Mr. Xavier for running into unreasonable people.

722871110.text: Paimon is saying that she feels sorry for these bad guys.

722871114.text: What are you talking about, you brat? Looking for a fight?

722871201.text: This is not the first time I've seen you fight. But I still have to say that you're terrifying.

722871202.text: Good thing we're friends. A hundred Xaviers wouldn't be a match for you...

722871205.text: I'm relieved then. The following scene requires you to channel the vigor of your fighting self.

722871206.text: There aren't many lines for you in this scene, but you can still take a look at it.

722871207.text: We will begin when you're ready.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Xavier to begin the shoot

722871601.text: Good. You all said your lines naturally and didn't make any mistakes.

722871603.text: I added more lines for them. And even used their real names for the characters after obtaining their permission...

722871604.text: #Ignore those bullies. If it hadn't been for {NICKNAME}, this scene wouldn't have been shot.

722871608.text: You delivered a smooth performance in that scene. Keep up this level and the next big scene will be no problem at all.

722871609.text: Oh yes, there is one more scene next.

722871610.text: Yes, I thought about it yesterday when I wrote the script, and this last scene must be shot in a place with a cliff. The <color=#00E1FFFF>small island</color> to the east of <color=#00E1FFFF>Narukami Island</color> is very suitable.

722871611.text: Well, this next scene on location is the key to the whole script, and I want to use the <color=#00E1FFFF>glow of sunset</color> as the backdrop.

722871612.text: All of us have been shooting continuously for a long time, so we should take this time to rest. Let's meet <color=#00E1FFFF>tomorrow evening</color> at the designated location.

722871701.text: The third act requires a little more from Mr. Sasano. This new character, Wakayama Kojuurou, is Wakayama Keisuke's younger brother and it is more appropriate to have Mr. Sasano play him.

722871702.text: #You told me before, and I am mentally prepared. It's just... remember to pull your punches for that second fight scene, {NICKNAME}.

722871703.text: #Oh yes, the script! I forgot to hand the script to {NICKNAME}.

722871704.text: Look at me, all I'm thinking about is how to shoot the next scene and I forgot to give you the script. I am so sorry.

722871705.text: With past experiences from the first scenes, I believe you are already familiar with the way we shoot.

722871706.text: #Huh? {M#He}{F#She} has to jump off a cliff at the end? That's really dangerous.

722871708.text: Yeah, you're used to jumping off high places and stuff, but now that you're doing it before a Film Kamera, you need to act more realistically.

722871709.text: And if that gets you into an accident, Paimon guesses it wouldn't be worth it, huh?

722871711.text: Paimon knows you're used to facing all sorts of danger but you cannot think of yourself as an invincible person made of steel.

722871712.text: #Dear Miss Paimon, we do not need {NICKNAME} to jump off a cliff here. {M#He}{F#She} just needs to glide down the cliff using a wind glider.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Xavier to begin the shoot

722872001.text: I still need more time to read the script.

722872101.text: Master Seishimaru, I've found you someone from the Wakayama Clan.

722872102.text: But Master Keisuke is already... gone. Please, let this all go.

722872103.text: Hmph. So, Kurotani, you must have come for revenge on my brother.

722872104.text: Now listen here. Keisuke worked himself to the bone day and night to settle the clan's affairs this entire year...

722872105.text: And it was all because of your stupid agreement.

722872109.text: You're a coward for placing sole blame on your father's executioner!

722872110.text: And you won't get your revenge now, no matter how much you want it.

722872111.text: You know why? That's because our father's already gone.

722872112.text: Kurotani, you didn't have what it took to avenge your adoptive parents!

722872113.text: And you wound up hurting Keisuke, who tried to persuade you with good intentions. You don't deserve to be called a samurai.

722872114.text: Keisuke once said that executioners must be prepared to suffer retaliation.

722872115.text: If you can't even stomach that, then you can forget about charging into battle and taking the lives of others.

722872117.text: Then I, his younger brother, Wakayama Kojuurou, am willing to take his place.

subQuests.subQuestName: Land safely in the designated location

722872201.text: As long as you don't kill me, I'll devote my life to seeking revenge, and I won't rest until one of us is dead.

722872205.text: Well, it's fortunate that no one died. Just give it a rest, both of you!

722872206.text: Look at this fuss you're both making...

722872207.text: Clan this, revenge that — what about these vague notions is worth all this trouble anyway?

722872208.text: I just sell tea. As long as I can eat my fill, I'm happy.

722872209.text: I couldn't care less what my last name is!

722872210.text: I don't have much of a way with words...

722872211.text: But rain falls into the lake, the lake water evaporates, and rain falls from the sky again.

722872212.text: Even if that rain water freezes, it will become sweet tea if you heat it over a stove.

722872213.text: Who cares whether the tea you were served came from the sky, the lake...

722872215.text: Um... This might sound like sophistry.

722872216.text: But I'm telling you both to stop this fighting now so you can go home to eat.

722870702.text: I've heard that you're in charge of the Kurotani Clan's affairs now.

722870703.text: Looks like the dust has settled since that incident.

722870704.text: Lord and Lady Kurotani are gone...

722870705.text: #But you're taking up the mantle as their eldest {M#son}{F#daughter} to continue to serve the public.

722870706.text: I'm sure they would be pleased.

722870710.text: You? You want to take revenge?

722870712.text: How can you still be just as impulsive as you were back then?

722870713.text: *sigh* With Lord Kurotani's abilities, the investigation never should have gone as wrong as it did.

722870714.text: But he said himself that he was willing to accept the blame and punishment.

722870715.text: The punishment from the great lords was indeed harsh...

722870716.text: But Lord Kurotani asked for it himself. I fear that there is still much left unsaid here.

722870717.text: Kurotani and Wakayama are both reputable clans.

722870718.text: You now carry the clan name. You're a samurai in service of the public.

722870720.text: So no matter how angry you are, you must be patient right now. You mustn't seek revenge.

722870721.text: What's suspicious is some of the great lords' men!

722870722.text: They've been mighty pleased with themselves since my father's death.

722870723.text: That's your anger clouding your judgment. They didn't necessarily have anything to do with it. Calm down!

722871301.text: We will begin when you're ready.

722871501.text: I still need more time to read the script.

722872401.text: The payment isn't actually that important to me. I applied for the job because I was interested in filming.

722872402.text: Xavier is a man of ideas, but that script was a little weird...

722872501.text: Please rest assured that I will treat film acting as an important form of training, and I am ready to risk my life for it.

722872502.text: I've memorized the lines, and while I'm not very good at doing the "emotions" Mr. Xavier talked about, I will do my best to learn!

722873001.text: *sigh* I'm not much of a fighter. Remember to pull your punches for the fight scene.

722873101.text: The next scene is a bit dangerous. Do be careful.
